title: VerificationResult
description: The outcome of an independent verifier Principal checking one Evidence bundle: a binary verdict plus human-readable reasoning.

result_id.description: Unique identifier for this verification result.

evidence_id.description: evidence_id of the Evidence bundle that was verified.

principal_id.description: principal_id of the verifier Principal that produced this result.

verdict.description: 'verified' if the evidence checks out, 'rejected' otherwise. There is no neutral verdict; withhold the result instead.

reasoning.description: Human-readable explanation of why the verdict was reached.

verified_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp at which verification completed.

extensions.description: Open bag for vendor or profile extensions. Keys SHOULD be namespaced (e.g. 'vendor.example/field').
